stories.blurb: Real Madrid player must help improve defensive solidity Scott, Hall, Lewis-Skelly and Calvert-Lewin selected Thomas Tuchel has told Trent ­Alexander-Arnold he must bring…
stories.summary: Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Myles Lewis-Skelly: Real Madrid player must help improve defensive solidity Scott, Hall, Lewis-Skelly and Calvert-Lewin selected Thomas Tuchel has told Trent ­Alexander-Arnold he must bring defensive solidity to the England squad after giving him a surprise recall for the upcoming Nations League matches. The head coach has selected the Real Madrid right-back only once before - for the games against Andorra and Senegal in June last year. Tuchel made headlines when he did so by urging Alexander-Arnold to focus on the defensive side of his game or risk a slip that could undermine the team’s World Cup campaign. Board reading of Guardian Football.

stories.headline: Pino kickstarts Crystal Palace’s Europa League rout of Lech Poznan to ease Sage’s worries
stories.blurb: It was worth the wait for Crystal Palace.
stories.summary: Jaydee Canvot, Marcus Tavernier, Francisco Evanilson, Adrien Truffert, Đorđe Petrović, Justin Kluivert, Ryan Christie, Bafodé Diakité, David Brooks and James Justin: It was worth the wait for Crystal Palace. After being denied their rightful place in the Europa League last season, Pierre Sage’s side made the perfect debut by brushing aside Lech Poznan with a victory that will take some of the heat off their new manager. The Frenchman has big shoes to fill in replacing Oliver Glasner after his predecessor won three trophies in 12 months and there had been some talk of disquiet behind the scenes following his decision to drop the teenager Jaydee Canvot at the weekend.
